reply:
The cause is the rule text, not a claude-settings guard. CLAUDE.md rule roles-one-role-per-agent says every lane that touches a screen gets a designer, with no exception, and no claude-settings hook checks it. A child repo's guard may enforce it; lane child-guard-promotion is surveying those. New step small-text-skips-designer: a lane that only changes text on an existing screen skips the designer, and the design reviewer still checks the result. The coordinator starts it.

Update 21:38 CST Nov 7: small-text-skips-designer is done, merged; child-guard-promotion is done, merged. Source: the roadmap. Triage.
text: I have also received feedback that small text changes on existing screens currently can't skip a designer agent -- this is clearly a scenario where the guards are making unintentional outcomes from what i desire.
